alternative to git , sync automatically instantly with no need for commits and pushes
hey I code in python from 2 different pcs , it's always a pain to keep commiting and pushing , opening your laptop and realise you forgot to push your last commit and now you have to go back home to work on it again ...  
is there a solution that my project folder is automatically synced across my 2 pcs so everytime i type anything or add a file or a folder it's synced in both pc ?   
hopefully there's a free solution to this because i won't need a lot of storage these are small project in size  
thanks in advance
